$comment: A local stack: the real Octopus and Coralogix adapters, pointed at the mocks that
`bun run dev:stack` starts. Only the base URL differs from a real deployment —
the providers, the mapping and the paging are the production code paths.
bun run dev:stack                                   # the two mocks
bun run db:up && bun run db:migrate                 # the store
SOURCES_ALLOW_FIXTURES is required here and only here: naming a fixture provider
in a connections file is refused otherwise, so a production file cannot quietly
serve seeded numbers. It is needed because there is no real cloud provider yet —
the Azure one is increment 5 of the data-source spec and is not built.
